!kick.Label: Kick player
!kick.Description: Kicks the chosen player from the server.

!afk.Label: Kick AFK players
!afk.Description: Kicks all AFK players right away. Takes no argument.

!ban.Label: Ban player
!ban.Description: Bans the chosen player and kicks them.

!team.Label: Move to team
!team.Description: Moves a player to a team; without a player it moves you.

!silence.Label: Silence chat
!silence.Description: Stops the chosen player from sending chat messages.

!unsilence.Label: Unsilence chat
!unsilence.Description: Lets the chosen player send chat messages again.

!mute.Label: Mute voice
!mute.Description: Stops the chosen player from sending voice messages.

!unmute.Label: Unmute voice
!unmute.Description: Lets the chosen player send voice messages again.

!cmdrban.Label: Ban from commander
!cmdrban.Description: Restricts the chosen player to infantry, no commander role.

!removecommanderban.Label: Lift commander ban
!removecommanderban.Description: Allows the chosen player to apply as commander again.

!demote.Label: Demote commander
!demote.Description: Demotes the commander of a team; without a team it uses your own team.

!eject.Label: Eject driver
!eject.Description: Ejects the chosen player from the vehicle they are driving.

!map.Label: Change map
!map.Description: Changes the map. Arguments: optionally a game mode after the map.

!unban.Label: Unban player
!unban.Description: Removes the chosen player from the ban list.

!banid.Label: Ban by SteamID
!banid.Description: Bans an offline player. Arguments: Steam64 ID, then the player name.

!chipmunk.Label: Chipmunk voices
!chipmunk.Description: Toggles chipmunk voice mode for everyone. Takes no argument.

/commander.Label: Apply commander
/commander.Description: Toggles your application for commander during the pre-round countdown.

/mutiny.Label: Vote mutiny
/mutiny.Description: Votes to replace your current commander. Takes no argument.

!endround.Label: End round
!endround.Description: Ends the current round once the game has started. Takes no argument.

/nominate.Label: Nominate map
/nominate.Description: Nominates a map for the next vote. Arguments: optionally a game mode after the map.

/rtv.Label: Rock the vote
/rtv.Description: Votes to start a map vote. Takes no argument.

currentmap.Label: Current map
currentmap.Description: Shows the current map to you. Takes no argument.

nextmap.Label: Next map
nextmap.Description: Shows the next map in the cycle and rounds left. Takes no argument.

mapcycle.Label: Show map cycle
mapcycle.Description: Lists the maps in the map cycle to you. Takes no argument.

!resources.Label: Give resources
!resources.Description: Gives or takes resources. Arguments: amount (negative takes), then optional team name.

!spawn.Label: Spawn object
!spawn.Description: Spawns an object at your position. Arguments: the object name.

!undospawn.Label: Undo last spawn
!undospawn.Description: Destroys the last object you spawned. Takes no argument.

!saveconfig.Label: Save spawn config
!saveconfig.Description: Saves all spawned objects to a json file. Arguments: file name.

!loadconfig.Label: Load spawn config
!loadconfig.Description: Removes current objects, loads a saved file. Arguments: file name.

!addconfig.Label: Add spawn config
!addconfig.Description: Keeps current objects and adds a saved file. Arguments: file name.

/surrender.Label: Vote surrender
/surrender.Description: Votes for your team to surrender. Takes no argument.

/techglitch.Label: Fix tech tier
/techglitch.Description: Commander only, before the round: forces a tech tier sync for the team.

!time.Label: Set time of day
!time.Description: Sets the game time, no value shows it. Arguments: hour from 0.0 to 23.99.

!devour.Label: Worm on player
!devour.Description: Spawns a Great Worm next to the chosen player.

!mapdump.Label: Dump map data
!mapdump.Description: Writes map info, refinery and HQ scans to UserData/MapBalance (Si_MapBalance tooling).

/formationsize.Label: Group size for a player
/formationsize.Description: Maximum FPS group size for one player this match. After the player: 1..50.

/formationsizeglobal.Label: Group size, match-wide
/formationsizeglobal.Description: Maximum FPS group size for everyone this match, leader included. Arguments: 1..50.

/formationsizecommander.Label: Commander order size
/formationsizecommander.Description: Maximum units per commander formation order. Arguments: 1..100, or status.

/Formationspeedcap.Label: Speed cap near arrival
/Formationspeedcap.Description: Faster units are capped near the final arrival point; centre-based pacing stays active.

/formationTravel.Label: Travel distance
/formationTravel.Description: Locked formation travel distance this match. Arguments: metres 0..10000.

/formationTolerance.Label: Slot tolerance
/formationTolerance.Description: Slot tolerance as percent of the nearest-neighbour spacing. Arguments: 10..100.

/FormationFallof.Label: Slowdown trigger
/FormationFallof.Description: Percent outside the slot tolerance that triggers the slowdown. Arguments: 10..90.

/startdelay.Label: Start delay
/startdelay.Description: Departure delays of a formation; the usage reply lists the lock forms. Arguments: see usage.

/startdelaylock.Label: Start delay, lock
/startdelaylock.Description: Departure delay for locked formations. Arguments: seconds.

/startdelaysoftlock.Label: Start delay, soft lock
/startdelaysoftlock.Description: Departure delay for soft-locked formations. Arguments: seconds.

/startdelayspeedlock.Label: Start delay, speed lock
/startdelayspeedlock.Description: Departure delay for speed-locked formations. Arguments: seconds.
